svg.title: Three ways to push a merry-go-round
svg.desc: The same 250-newton push is applied at the edge perpendicular to the radius, at half the radius, and at the edge 30 degrees from the radius. The first gives 6.67 radians per second squared; the other two give half as much. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Torque, not force alone, sets the angular acceleration
The same 250-N push on a 50.0-kg, 1.50-m merry-go-round (I = 56.3 kg·m²). Halving the lever arm, or
pushing at 30° to the radius, halves τ = rF sin θ.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
